description: Canonical fill of the stage-1 orientation document. Sealing branch: a § 5.2(a)(3)-excluded conviction, no certificate issued yet, eligibility not resting on military service, no prior Board petition and no prior clemency petition. Every value is obviously synthetic. Board hearing date, Board decision, judge, State's Attorney, fee amounts and all protected and outside-party fields stay blank.

additionalFacts: The Acknowledgement form must be completed before the application and included with the petition, or the petition is rejected and returned.
The declaration that all assertions are complete, truthful and accurate must be signed and sworn before a notary public. Perjury is a Class 3 felony punishable by up to 10 years.
The completed petition must be received at least 75 days before the first date of the hearing schedule to be considered on that docket.
A copy goes to the sentencing or chief judge of the county of conviction and to the current State's Attorney of that county, with proof of delivery demonstrated to the Board.
No petition will be accepted for review within four years of the denial of a prior petition for the same individual, unless the Chairman permits an exception for compelling reasons.

Stage 1 is a self-help stop condition: the certificate application is a discretionary rehabilitation case. Referral destination is the Office of the State Appellate Defender, Expungement Unit, 866-787-1776.
